headline: 12 addresses catalogued across NEAR, EVM chains, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, Stellar, Sui, Aptos, Tron, XRP, Cardano, Starknet; primary settlement contract is intents.near on NEAR Protocol.

findings.text: D1: No EVM name-tag search performed — the primary contract (intents.near) is on NEAR Protocol (non-EVM), so Etherscan/Basescan/Arbiscan name-tag searches are not applicable for the core contract. EVM treasury address 0x2CfF890f0378a11913B6129B2E97417a2c302680 and HOT Bridge address 0x233c5370CCfb3cD7409d9A3fb98ab94dE94Cb4Cd were discovered via docs (D2). Block-explorer name-tag lookups for these EVM addresses were not fetched this run — recorded in unknowns[].

D2: Official treasury/addresses doc found at https://docs.near-intents.org/security-compliance/treasury-addresses.md. Lists NEAR Intents treasury addresses across EVM chains (one shared address), Bitcoin forks, L1s (Solana, TON, Stellar, Sui, Aptos, Starknet, TRON, XRP, Cardano), and refill addresses. Also identifies intents.near as the Verifier contract on NEAR. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to this URL.

D3: Security page at https://docs.near-intents.org/security-compliance/security.md links to audit reports at Google Drive folder https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eNHI_GKsbmMSjeCENRklvtVh8imGSUvy — folder was not fetched this run; no specific audit firm names, dates, or in-scope addresses recoverable from the docs page itself. Recorded in unknowns[].

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/near/intents confirmed as source of the Verifier (defuse) smart contract. Releases page shows latest release defuse/v0.4.2 with SHA256 hash for defuse.wasm. No pinned deployment artifact files (run-latest.json, deployments.json) were fetched; contract deployed at intents.near on NEAR mainnet confirmed from docs. Controller sub-module (controller/README.md) referenced but not fetched.

D5: Multi-chain enumeration completed via treasury docs. NEAR Intents operates treasury/bridge addresses on: EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, Aurora, Gnosis, Berachain, XLayer, Monad — shared address 0x2CfF890f0378a11913B6129B2E97417a2c302680), Bitcoin, BCH, Dash, Dogecoin, Litecoin, Zcash, Solana, TON, Stellar, Sui, Aptos, Starknet, TRON, XRP, Cardano. Non-EVM addresses are not fetchable via defipunkd surfacers. Refill addresses catalogued separately per chain.

D6: PoA Token and PoA Factory contract noted in GitHub README as part of the ecosystem (Proof of Authority bridge contracts on NEAR). No factory address for PoA token factory was discoverable from fetched docs or GitHub search results this run. Recorded in unknowns[].

D7: Role taxonomy applied: intents.near = vault/verifier (on-chain settlement); 0x2CfF890f0378a11913B6129B2E97417a2c302680 = treasury (EVM chains); 0x233c5370CCfb3cD7409d9A3fb98ab94dE94Cb4Cd = treasury (HOT Bridge, EVM); 0xbb2f33f73ccc2c74e3fb9bb8eb75241ac15337e0 = other (EVM refill); HWjmoUNYckccg9Qrwi43JTzBcGcM1nbdAtATf9GXmz16 = treasury (Solana, NEAR Intents); 8sXzdKW2jFj7V5heRwPMcygzNH3JZnmie5ZRuNoTuKQC = treasury (Solana, HOT Bridge).

D8: All admin_addresses[] entries trace to the treasury addresses page fetched at https://docs.near-intents.org/security-compliance/treasury-addresses.md and the Verifier contract introduction at https://docs.near-intents.org/integration/verifier-contract/introduction.md. Non-EVM addresses (Bitcoin, Solana, TON, etc.) are included in admin_addresses[] with role='treasury' but cannot be verified via defipunkd on-chain API (non-supported chains). actor_class set to 'unknown' for these.

rationale.verdict: Walked official docs (near-intents.org), GitHub (near/intents), and the treasury addresses page. Catalogued 12+ addresses across 15+ chains: 1 primary NEAR settlement contract (intents.near), 2 shared EVM treasury addresses covering 12+ EVM chains, 1 EVM refill address, and 8 chain-specific treasury/refill addresses on Solana, TON, Bitcoin forks, Stellar, Sui, Aptos, TRON, XRP, Cardano, and Starknet. Audit PDF contents, PoA factory address, and EVM block-explorer name tags remain uninspected.

Complete documentation index for NEAR Intents, listing all available pages including verifier contract introduction, treasury addresses, security, and bridging overview.
Verifier smart contract deployed at intents.near on NEAR mainnet. Source code at https://github.com/near/intents. No testnet deployment. Former name is 'Defuse'.

Official treasury and refill addresses for NEAR Intents and HOT Bridge across all chains. EVM treasury: 0x2CfF890f0378a11913B6129B2E97417a2c302680; HOT Bridge EVM: 0x233c5370CCfb3cD7409d9A3fb98ab94dE94Cb4Cd; EVM refill: 0xbb2f33f73ccc2c74e3fb9bb8eb75241ac15337e0; Solana NEAR Intents: HWjmoUNYckccg9Qrwi43JTzBcGcM1nbdAtATf9GXmz16; Solana HOT Bridge: 8sXzdKW2jFj7V5heRwPMcygzNH3JZnmie5ZRuNoTuKQC; intents.near listed as NEAR treasury.
Audit reports linked at Google Drive folder. Bug bounty via Hackenproof at https://hackenproof.com/programs/near-intents. AML portal at https://aml.near-intents.org/.

Three bridge types: Omni Bridge (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BNB, Solana, Bitcoin), POA Bridge (widest chain set including UTXO chains, Sui, Aptos, Cardano, Starknet), HOT Bridge (BNB, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, Scroll, Monad, TON, Stellar). Each has its own trust model.
Primary GitHub repository for NEAR Intents. Contains Verifier/Defuse smart contract, PoA Token and PoA factory contract for Proof of Authority bridge. Contract deployed at intents.near.
Latest release defuse/v0.4.2 with defuse.wasm artifact. SHA256: f67f9559b3b512c52dfa11723a28b9119bcf773ac01780370d6409e5f1fb20e5.

protocol_metadata.about: NEAR Intents is an intent-based cross-chain swap and bridging protocol where users (or AI agents) declare desired outcomes (e.g. 'swap 1 BTC for USDC') and competing market makers fill orders at the best available price. Settlement occurs atomically via the Verifier smart contract deployed at intents.near on NEAR Protocol, which acts as an internal ledger tracking balances across participants. Asset movement to and from external blockchains (35+ networks including Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, and TON) is handled by three bridge types: Omni Bridge, POA Bridge, and HOT Bridge, each with distinct chain coverage and trust models.
